reference: Predeclared J10,J40;16 comparisons; Bartlett HAC120; per-connection intercepts

all.standard_errors: Bartlett HAC with connection/segment fixed intercepts
all.interpretation: Exploration-innovation response under the observed feedback/compensation policy. Persistent-action extrapolation is heuristic, not an identified Q gradient. visible_* are Poisson-weighted descriptive response summaries. Fitted lambda does not identify a neural critic horizon or exclude within-class gradient learning. The truncated Poisson mass is not a response-error bound.
